convo.corpse.comrade.say.2.neutral: You stood with {slot.faction.name}, {target.name}. We won't forget.
convo.corpse.comrade.say.3.neutral: We fought side by side, {target.name}. Rest easy.
convo.corpse.comrade.say.4.neutral: {target.name} held the line. We'll carry on.
convo.corpse.comrade.say.5.neutral: I hope {slot.faction.name} remembers what you gave.
convo.corpse.friend.say.1.neutral: We were supposed to get through this together, {target.name}.
convo.corpse.friend.say.2.neutral: You always had my back, {target.name}. I should've had yours.
convo.corpse.friend.say.3.neutral: I won't let them forget you, {target.name}.
convo.corpse.friend.say.5.neutral: We still owed each other a drink, {target.name}.
convo.corpse.hostile.say.1.neutral: So this is how it ends for you, {target.name}.
convo.corpse.hostile.say.2.neutral: You made plenty of enemies, {target.name}. I was one.
convo.corpse.hostile.say.3.neutral: I won't mourn you, {target.name}, but I won't forget this.
convo.corpse.hostile.say.4.neutral: The threat is gone. Keep moving.
convo.corpse.hostile.say.5.neutral: Maybe you finally found some peace, {target.name}.
convo.corpse.neutral.say.1.neutral: I didn't know you, {target.name}. You deserved better.
convo.corpse.neutral.say.2.neutral: I hope someone remembers your name, {target.name}.
convo.corpse.neutral.say.3.neutral: This place takes everyone, doesn't it?
convo.corpse.neutral.say.4.neutral: Someone should have found you sooner, {target.name}.
convo.corpse.neutral.say.5.neutral: Rest now, {target.name}. I won't leave you unnamed.
convo.corpse.relative.say.3.neutral: You should have made it home, {target.name}.
convo.corpse.relative.say.4.neutral: I'll carry you with me, {target.name}. I promise.
convo.corpse.revenge.comrade.say.1.neutr: Damn {slot.killer.name}. {target.name} stood with {slot.faction.name}; we will answer for this.
convo.corpse.revenge.comrade.say.2.neutr: One of ours is down, {target.name}. {slot.killer.name} made enemies of all of us.
convo.corpse.revenge.comrade.say.3.neutr: We saw {slot.killer.name} take {target.name}. This is not finished.
convo.corpse.revenge.comrade.say.4.neutr: {slot.killer.name} killed a member of {slot.faction.name}. We will remember.
convo.corpse.revenge.comrade.say.5.neutr: Run while you can, {slot.killer.name}. We will not forget what happened to {target.name}.
convo.corpse.revenge.comrade.say.6.neutr: Hell, {target.name}. {slot.killer.name} will pay for making us weaker.
convo.corpse.revenge.comrade.say.7.neutr: {slot.faction.name} lost one today. {slot.killer.name} started something they cannot finish.
convo.corpse.revenge.comrade.say.8.neutr: We do not forget our own, {target.name}. {slot.killer.name} will answer for this.
convo.corpse.revenge.friend.say.1.neutra: Damn {slot.killer.name}. {target.name} was my friend, and this will cost you.
convo.corpse.revenge.friend.say.2.neutra: I saw {target.name} fall. {slot.killer.name} will answer for it.
convo.corpse.revenge.friend.say.3.neutra: Hell, {target.name}. What {slot.killer.name} did will not be forgotten.
convo.corpse.revenge.friend.say.4.neutra: I will not let {target.name} be forgotten, and {slot.killer.name} will not get away with it.
convo.corpse.revenge.friend.say.5.neutra: {target.name} always had my back. Today, I am coming for {slot.killer.name}.
convo.corpse.revenge.friend.say.7.neutra: I hope {slot.killer.name} knows what they took from us when they killed {target.name}.
convo.corpse.revenge.friend.say.8.neutra: No more warnings. {slot.killer.name} killed one of ours, {target.name}.
convo.corpse.revenge.relative.say.1.neut: Damn it, {slot.killer.name}. You took {target.name} from their family. This will not go unanswered.
convo.corpse.revenge.relative.say.2.neut: I saw {target.name} fall. {slot.killer.name} will answer for this, I swear it.
convo.corpse.revenge.relative.say.3.neut: What {slot.killer.name} did to {target.name} will never be forgiven.
convo.corpse.revenge.relative.say.4.neut: Hell, {target.name}. {slot.killer.name} is going to pay for this.
convo.corpse.revenge.relative.say.5.neut: I will not let {target.name}'s death go unanswered. {slot.killer.name} started this.
convo.corpse.revenge.relative.say.6.neut: No. Not {target.name}. {slot.killer.name} just made this personal.
convo.corpse.revenge.relative.say.8.neut: Rest now, {target.name}. I hope {slot.killer.name} runs, because I am coming.
